# Screen sharing and portal comparison

Screen sharing passes only when an external client receives actual frames through PipeWire after explicit portal approval. A portal that returns a node id, a stream that negotiates and delivers nothing, and a screenshot API that writes a black PNG all fail this matrix. The approval step is part of the test, not a precondition to it.

| Gate | Mandatory | Smithay | libmutter |
|---|---|---|---|
| real screen sharing through portals and PipeWire | **yes** | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| real screenshots through a portal | no | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |

Recorded reasons:

- compositor/bunny-mutter-v4 has no downstream shell implementation yet, so there is nothing to measure.
- not executed in V4. The V3 prototype is the starting point; no V4 measurement has been made.

## Status

No gate in this matrix has been measured. Nothing here supports a framework selection, and nothing here may be cited as qualification evidence.
